title: An amount the agent left out
say: डेढ़ लाख का cheque वीरवार को मिलेगा।
note: The model logs the day and silently drops the amount. The evidence puts it back.

title: One digit of a phone number
say: मेरा नंबर नोट करो: सात एक, डबल सेवन डबल एट, आठ सात एक सात।
note: The first digit is misheard. Three other recognisers and the acoustic model say seven.

title: Evidence is split, so it asks
say: callback number है सिक्स फ़ाइव एट नाइन, ज़ीरो एक तीन, टू फ़ोर फ़ाइव।
note: The recognisers disagree on a single digit, so the agent asks about that digit only.

title: A Hindi fraction, misheard
hint: Hindi: सवा दो लाख and a date
say: अभी सवा दो लाख भेज रहा हूँ, बाकी तीस तारीख को।
note: "सवा दो लाख" is two and a quarter lakh. The model alone often drops or changes the quarter.
